# Harrison

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P3](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0003), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Harrison is a short, fat, and bald man with a round face. He has prominent blue eyes that stick out almost completely when he becomes purple with rage.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011)_

## Personality

A sober, middle-aged man, Harrison self-identifies as a crusty, lonesome, crabbed, and hasty person who speaks with plain outspokenness. Though considered an odd crank by some, he is also known to be an awfully kind man who displays outward sympathy while keeping his chuckles private.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P23](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0023), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P25](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0025), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040), +2 more_

## History

A native of [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick) who had visited Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island) as a boy, Mr. J. A. Harrison lived in Scottsford, [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick), where his sister kept house for him until her death. Upon his sister's advice, he married [Emily](../character/emily.md) Scott, a woman with her own money and strict standards of housekeeping, but the couple eventually separated due to a dispute over his parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md). Moving to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), he bought a local farm and lived alone as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's neighbor. Their initial meeting was contentious when he confronted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her Jersey cow trespassing in his oats. Shortly thereafter, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally sold Harrison's cow, but he forgave her, accepted her cow in exchange, and invited her to tea, beginning a friendly relationship. Though he remained skeptical of Anne's teaching methods and refused to subscribe to the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society), he frequently engaged in cheerful conversations with her.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P14](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0014), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P16](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0016), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P17](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0017), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P18](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0018), +438 more_

## Quotes

> "Sorry, miss! Sorry isn’t going to help matters any. You’d better go and look at the havoc that animal has made in my oats . . . trampled them from center to circumference, miss."
>
> — Harrison — [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P17](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0017)

> "He’s . . . he’s always talking nonsense. I got him from my brother who was a sailor. Sailors don’t always use the choicest language, and parrots are very imitative birds."
>
> — Harrison — [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P6](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0006)

> "has she gone and broken into my oats again? Well, never mind . . . never mind if she has. It’s no difference . . . none at all, I . . . I was too hasty yesterday, that’s a fact. Never mind if she has."
>
> — Harrison — [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P9](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0009)

> "I don’t, that’s a fact, and I’m mighty fond of it, too. I’m much obliged to you. It looks good on top. I hope it’s good all the way through."
>
> — Harrison — [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P29](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0029)

> "Well, I’ll tell you what, miss, you must help me eat it. I’ll put the kettle on and we’ll have a cup of tea. How will that do?"
>
> — Harrison — [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P31](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0031)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--harrison.md)

Harrison and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) first meet as antagonistic neighbors when he furiously confronts her over a cow trespassing in his oats. Their rocky start quickly transforms into a warm, neighborly friendship after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally sells Harrison's cow and brings him a cake to apologize. The two frequently visit and share tea, regularly debating topics like school discipline and community projects.

- Friend of — neighborly friends  <sub>[v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043), +1 more</sub>

### [Emily](../character/emily.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/emily--harrison.md)

[Emily](../character/emily.md) is Harrison's wife, from whom he was previously separated due to a feud involving his parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md). Their sudden separation shocked the neighborhood, but following Ginger's death, [Emily](../character/emily.md) arrives in town and the pair reconcile. She cleans his home and re-establishes her place in his life, later attending community events alongside him.

- Spouse of — married couple who reconciled  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P9](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0009), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P2](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0002)</sub>

### [John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/harrison--john-henry-carter.md)

[John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md) is employed by Harrison to assist with farm chores and household labor. Following a severe storm that damages the local area and Harrison's property, John Henry continues working under Harrison's direction as the household recovers.

- Commands — hired worker for housekeeping and chores  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006)</sub>
